<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_0d9c2xk" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" exporter="Camunda Modeler" exporterVersion="5.28.0">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ClaimSubmitted" name="ClaimSubmitted"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_FraudAlert" name="FraudAlert"/>
  <bpmn:process id="claim-handling" camunda:candidateStarterGroups="claims" camunda:historyTimeToLive="P30D" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_claim" name="Claim submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toAssess</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_start" messageRef="Message_ClaimSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_assess" camunda:formKey="embedded:app:forms/assess-claim.html" camunda:candidateUsers="${assessors}" name="Assess claim">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:properties>
          <camunda:property name="sla" value="PT4H"/>
        </camunda:properties>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toAssess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toFraudCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_fraudCheck" camunda:class="com.acme.claims.FraudCheckDelegate" name="Check for fraud">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:field name="threshold">
          <camunda:string>0.8</camunda:string>
        </camunda:field>
        <camunda:field name="region" expression="${claim.region}"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toFraudCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toReviewItems</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_items" name="Review items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toReviewItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toPayout</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics camunda:collection="${claim.items}" camunda:elementVariable="item">
        <bpmn:completionCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nrOfCompletedInstances / nrOfInstances >= 0.6}</bpmn:completionCondition>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_item">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toPrice</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:scriptTask id="Task_price" scriptFormat="feel" camunda:resultVariable="itemPrice" name="Price item">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toPrice</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toItemEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:script>item.quantity * item.unitPrice</bpmn:script>
      </bpmn:scriptTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_item">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toItemEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toPrice" sourceRef="StartEvent_item" targetRef="Task_price"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toItemEnd" sourceRef="Task_price" targetRef="EndEvent_item"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_payout" name="Pay out claim">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:connector>
          <camunda:inputOutput>
            <camunda:inputParameter name="url">https://payments.example.invalid/payouts</camunda:inputParameter>
            <camunda:inputParameter name="method">POST</camunda:inputParameter>
          </camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:connectorId>http-connector</camunda:connectorId>
        </camunda:connector>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="payout">
            <camunda:map>
              <camunda:entry key="claimId">${claim.id}</camunda:entry>
              <camunda:entry key="currency">EUR</camunda:entry>
            </camunda:map>
          </camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="channels">
            <camunda:list>
              <camunda:value>email</camunda:value>
              <camunda:value>${claim.preferredChannel}</camunda:value>
            </camunda:list>
          </camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="note">Paid for ${claim.id}</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="audit">
            <camunda:script scriptFormat="groovy">claim.audit.collect { it.id }</camunda:script>
          </camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toPayout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toNotify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_paid" name="Claim paid">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toNotify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_paid" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="notify-claimant"/>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Signal_fraud" name="Fraud alert" attachedToRef="Task_assess">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toFraudEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_fraud" signalRef="Signal_FraudAlert"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_fraud" name="Claim blocked">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:executionListener event="end">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">execution.setVariable("blocked", true)</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toFraudEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toAssess" sourceRef="StartEvent_claim" targetRef="Task_assess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toFraudCheck" sourceRef="Task_assess" targetRef="Task_fraudCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toReviewItems" sourceRef="Task_fraudCheck" targetRef="SubProcess_items"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toPayout" sourceRef="SubProcess_items" targetRef="Task_payout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toNotify" sourceRef="Task_payout" targetRef="EndEvent_paid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toFraudEnd" sourceRef="Signal_fraud" targetRef="EndEvent_fraud"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_1" bpmnElement="claim-handling">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_claim_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_claim">
        <dc:Bounds x="152" y="182" width="36" height="36"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_assess_di" bpmnElement="Task_assess">
        <dc:Bounds x="240" y="160" width="100" height="80"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_fraudCheck_di" bpmnElement="Task_fraudCheck">
        <dc:Bounds x="390" y="160" width="100" height="80"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="SubProcess_items_di" bpmnElement="SubProcess_items" isExpanded="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="540" y="100" width="350" height="200"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_item_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_item">
        <dc:Bounds x="572" y="182" width="36" height="36"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_price_di" bpmnElement="Task_price">
        <dc:Bounds x="660" y="160" width="100" height="80"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_item_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_item">
        <dc:Bounds x="812" y="182" width="36" height="36"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_payout_di" bpmnElement="Task_payout">
        <dc:Bounds x="940" y="160" width="100" height="80"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_paid_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_paid">
        <dc:Bounds x="1092" y="182" width="36" height="36"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_fraud_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_fraud">
        <dc:Bounds x="352" y="322" width="36" height="36"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Signal_fraud_di" bpmnElement="Signal_fraud">
        <dc:Bounds x="272" y="222" width="36" height="36"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_toAssess_di" bpmnElement="Flow_toAssess">
        <di:waypoint x="188" y="200"/>
        <di:waypoint x="240" y="200"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_toFraudCheck_di" bpmnElement="Flow_toFraudCheck">
        <di:waypoint x="340" y="200"/>
        <di:waypoint x="390" y="200"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_toReviewItems_di" bpmnElement="Flow_toReviewItems">
        <di:waypoint x="490" y="200"/>
        <di:waypoint x="540" y="200"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_toPrice_di" bpmnElement="Flow_toPrice">
        <di:waypoint x="608" y="200"/>
        <di:waypoint x="660" y="200"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_toItemEnd_di" bpmnElement="Flow_toItemEnd">
        <di:waypoint x="760" y="200"/>
        <di:waypoint x="812" y="200"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_toPayout_di" bpmnElement="Flow_toPayout">
        <di:waypoint x="890" y="200"/>
        <di:waypoint x="940" y="200"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_toNotify_di" bpmnElement="Flow_toNotify">
        <di:waypoint x="1040" y="200"/>
        <di:waypoint x="1092" y="200"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_toFraudEnd_di" bpmnElement="Flow_toFraudEnd">
        <di:waypoint x="290" y="258"/>
        <di:waypoint x="290" y="340"/>
        <di:waypoint x="352" y="340"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
